Murderer |TV actor =[[Tony Robinette]] }} '''Shopkeep Simon''' is a resident of [[Freeside]] and alleged owner of [[Sonny's Sundries]] in [[Timeline (2250-2300)#2296|2296]] {{In|FOTV}}. ==Background== Sometime prior to [[Lucy MacLean|Lucy]]'s arrival to [[New Vegas]], Simon, self-admittedly naked at the time, entered the [[Sonny's Sundries]] general store in Freeside to rob it. Through unknown means, he ended up murdering the store's namesake proprietor, [[Sonny]]. Afterward, Simon stripped the corpse and began wearing his clothes (despite them being comically undersized for him) to pass himself off as the owner of Sonny's Sundries. He also shoddily dismembered Sonny's body and left the remains in a trash can in the back of the store. '''Shotgun Jeff''' is a resident of [[Freeside]] in [[Timeline (2250-2300)#2296|2296]] {{In|FOTV}}.

==Background==
"Shotgun" Jeff became the bartender for the [[Atomic Wrangler Casino]] sometime between [[Timeline (2250-2300)#2281|2281]] and 2296. 

By his own word, he has been around long enough to observe more than one "change in management" in [[New Vegas]] between the [[New California Republic]], [[Caesar's Legion]], a "robot army" (presumably [[Securitron]]s), and most recently a pack of [[Deathclaw (TV series)|deathclaws]] from [[Quarry Junction]]. He boasts that he will stick around as long as he does not have to pay taxes.<ref>Shotgun Jeff: ''"Guess you saw them Deathclaw things come up from Quarry Junction. They fightin' around the Strip. Big whup. Just another fuckin' round o' change in management's all it is. Like one of 'em merry-go-rounds. NCR. Legion. NCR. Legion. Fuckin' robots. No matter to me. Always somebody tryna tell us what to do. Long as they don't come 'round and charge me taxes, I don't give a fuck."''<br/ >({{FOTV|2|5}})</ref>
